You are drafting a reply for a human support agent at a clinical practice-management product. The agent will review and edit it before anything is sent. The ticket was escalated to a human for this reason: safety_rule:patient_data_exposure: Patient-data access or exposure always goes to a human. (also matched: suspected_outage, urgent_clinician) Acknowledge the customer's problem and say a member of the support team is handling it. Do not promise an outcome or a timeline. Give product steps only if a knowledge-base article is provided and it answers the ticket, and take them only from that article. Put the reply in draft.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: review_draft.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"additionalProperties": false, "description": "A suggested reply for the human agent who takes an escalation.", "properties": {"draft": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Draft", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["draft"], "title": "review_draft", "type": "object"}

Article: none

Ticket:
System freezing when trying to upload scanned paper lab reports

Hi, I don't know if your servers are having a major glitch right now, but none of us can attach outside scanned PDF lab reports to patient charts. Every time I try to drop a file in, the whole screen freezes up completely.

{
  "draft": "Hi,

Thank you for bringing this to our attention. I’m sorry you’re experiencing the system freeze when trying to attach scanned PDF lab reports. I’ve escalated this issue to our support team, and a specialist is currently reviewing the situation.

We appreciate your patience while we investigate further. If you have any additional details you’d like to share, please feel free to reply to this message.

[Support Team]"
